description: Sambalpuri saree shopping benchmark for the LangGraph sales agent. Grounded in the EVAL-0001..EVAL-0008 fixture catalog (see experiments/benchmarks/seed_eval_catalog.sql), not the real SAM-2026 business products.

cases.query: What kind of sarees do you have?
cases.notes: Open-ended discovery, no specific filter implied.

cases.query: Show me your Sambalpuri saree collection.
cases.notes: Same as discovery_001, different phrasing.

cases.query: Can you show me some sarees?
cases.notes: Same as discovery_001, different phrasing.

cases.query: I need a saree for a wedding.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0001, EVAL-0004, EVAL-0007 (EVAL-0007 is SOLD).

cases.query: Do you have anything for a festival?
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0002, EVAL-0003, EVAL-0005, EVAL-0008 (EVAL-0008 is RESERVED).

cases.query: I want something for a casual day out.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0006 only.

cases.query: Do you have maroon sarees?
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0001 (available) and EVAL-0007 (sold).

cases.query: Show me black sarees.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0002.

cases.query: I like blue, do you have any sarees in that color?
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0006.

cases.query: Do you have any silk sarees?
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0004 (available) and EVAL-0007 (sold).

cases.query: I prefer cotton sarees.
Any pure silk options for a wedding?
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0004 (available) and EVAL-0007 (sold).

cases.query: Do you have Pasapalli Bandha sarees?
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0004.

cases.query: I want a saree with Rudraksha Bandha weaving.
cases.notes: Only EVAL-0007 has this bandha_type and it is SOLD, so a default in-stock search should come back empty even with a correct argument.

cases.query: Do you have anything with a Shankha motif?
cases.notes: Neither search_products nor recommend_products currently exposes a motif filter (only bandha_type), so argument correctness is not gradable here. This case documents that gap rather than testing exact matching.

cases.query: I want a saree with 100 count thread.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0002, EVAL-0005 (available) and EVAL-0008 (reserved).

cases.query: Do you have anything with 120 thread count?
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0001 (available) and EVAL-0007 (sold).

cases.query: What's your highest thread count saree?
cases.notes: No tool supports a 'highest/max' query directly; the agent must fetch a broad list and reason over it. Highest available thread_count in the catalog is EVAL-0004 at 140.

cases.query: I have a budget of 5000, what can you show me?
cases.notes: Only recommend_products exposes a price filter (max_price); search_products has none. Matches EVAL-0001, 0003, 0005, 0006 (and EVAL-0002 at 5200 is just over budget).

cases.query: Show me sarees under 4000.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0003, EVAL-0006.

cases.query: What's the most affordable saree you have?
cases.notes: No tool supports a 'cheapest' query directly; the agent must fetch a list and pick the minimum itself. Cheapest available is EVAL-0006 at 2600.

cases.query: Do you have something between 3000 and 5000 rupees?
cases.notes: No tool exposes a min_price argument (only max_price), so the lower bound cannot be graded; only max_price=5000 is checked.

cases.query: Is the Rudraksha Bandha silk saree in stock?
cases.notes: EVAL-0007 is SOLD. Both tools default to in_stock_only=True, so the correct call should come back with zero results rather than describing the sold item.

cases.query: Do you have any pink sarees available right now?
cases.notes: EVAL-0008 is RESERVED, not AVAILABLE, so this should also come back empty.

cases.query: What sarees do you currently have in stock for a wedding?
cases.notes: Should surface EVAL-0001 and EVAL-0004; EVAL-0007 is sold and must not appear.

cases.query: Tell me more about EVAL-0001.
cases.notes: Direct SKU lookup.

cases.query: What's the price of EVAL-0004?
cases.notes: Direct SKU lookup; price is 9500 INR.

cases.query: Can you give me details on the Ivory Silk Pasapalli Wedding Saree?
cases.notes: get_product_details only accepts an exact SKU, not a product name, so the agent likely needs to search first to resolve EVAL-0004 before (or instead of) requesting details.

cases.query: Do you have any info on a saree called EVAL-0007?
cases.notes: get_product_details filters on product status=ACTIVE only, not inventory status, so it should still return EVAL-0007's details even though it is sold.

cases.query: Can you recommend a saree for my sister's wedding? She likes maroon.
cases.notes: Best in-stock match is EVAL-0001; EVAL-0007 also matches attributes but is sold.

cases.query: What would you suggest for a festival? My budget is 4500.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0003 and EVAL-0005 within budget.

cases.query: Recommend something silk for a wedding, under 10000.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0004 (9500, available); EVAL-0007 (12000) is over budget and sold.

cases.query: Hi
cases.notes: Plain greeting, no product intent yet. Soft expectation, not a strict requirement.

cases.query: Can you help me?
cases.notes: No concrete product criteria given yet. Soft expectation.

cases.query: I want something nice.
cases.notes: Genuinely underspecified; ideally the agent asks a clarifying question instead of guessing. Interpret this category's accuracy qualitatively.

cases.query: I want a maroon silk saree for a wedding, budget 12000.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0007 exactly on attributes, but it is sold, so the in-stock result should be empty.

cases.query: Show me cotton festival sarees with 100 thread count.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0002 (available) and EVAL-0008 (reserved).

cases.query: I need a casual blue cotton saree.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0006 exactly.

cases.query: Find me a Traditional Bandha saree in black for a festival, under 6000.
cases.notes: Matches EVAL-0002 exactly (5200, available).

turns: Do you have any wedding sarees?
What's the price of the first one?
cases.notes: Tests whether the agent carries SKU context from turn 1 into a follow-up. Which SKU 'the first one' refers to depends on the model's own earlier ordering, so exact arguments are not graded.

turns: Do you have anything silk in that color?
cases.notes: Tests whether color preference from turn 1 carries into turn 2's tool call alongside the new fabric constraint.

Ideal behavior reuses the product list and prices already returned in turn 1 rather than calling a tool again. Soft expectation, since recommend_products also with max reasoning is a defensible alternative.
